questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to a successful root canal treatment?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Disinfection and sealing are the keys to success.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will focus on these two aspects.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'Why is the rubber dam mandatory in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: To isolate the tooth and prevent salivary contamination
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The rubber dam isolates the tooth, prevents contamination, and protects the airway.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always use the rubber dam.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is working length?' Mina answers:
options: The distance from the crown to the apex
The distance from the reference point to the apical foramen
The total length of the root
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Working length is the distance from the coronal reference to the apical foramen.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always measure with the locator.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to determine working length accurately?' Mina answers:
options: With an apex locator confirmed by radiograph
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The combination of locator + radiograph is the most reliable.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always use both.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is crown-down instrumentation?' Mina answers:
options: An instrumentation technique from apex to crown
An instrumentation technique from crown to apex
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The crown-down technique allows progressive debridement and reduces the risk of ledges.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use this technique.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is the most commonly used irrigation solution in endodontics?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Sodium hypochlorite is the reference solution for disinfection.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use it with caution.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What concentration of hypochlorite is recommended?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Concentrations of 2.5 to 5.25% are effective for disinfection.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use a concentration of 2.5%.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risks of hypochlorite extrusion?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Hypochlorite extrusion can cause severe inflammatory reactions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will pay attention to pressure.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is gutta-percha?' Mina answers:
options: A root canal filling material made of natural rubber
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Gutta-percha is the standard material for canal obturation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use gutta-percha.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is the role of sealer cement in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: Fill the spaces between gutta-percha and dentin
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Sealer cement ensures the sealing of the obturation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always use sealer cement.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is lateral condensation in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: An obturation technique with gutta-percha compression
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Lateral condensation is a classic obturation technique.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use this technique.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of thermoplasticized gutta-percha?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Thermoplasticized gutta-percha better conforms to canal morphology.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use thermoplasticized gutta-percha.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a calcified canal?' Mina answers:
options: With active tip files and patience
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Calcified canals require special files and patience.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take my time.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to identify additional canals?' Mina answers:
options: By the color of the tooth
By the size of the crown
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Careful exploration is the key to finding all canals.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always look for additional canals.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How many canals does a maxillary molar have?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Maxillary molars often have 4 canals, including a frequently overlooked mesio-lingual one.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always look for the 4th canal.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is apical patency?' Mina answers:
options: Maintaining the apical foramen open after instrumentation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Apical patency ensures the permeability of the foramen.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will maintain patency.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of Nickel-Titanium files?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'NiTi files are more flexible and better follow curvatures.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use NiTi files.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to avoid file fracture?' Mina answers:
options: Use appropriate files and do not force
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Never force a file and use them with caution.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will be careful.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What to do in case of file fracture in the canal?' Mina answers:
options: Attempt to remove it with special instruments
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Special instruments and ultrasonics can often remove the fractured file.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will try to remove it.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When can a fractured file be left in the canal?' Mina answers:
options: If it is confined within the canal and does not extend beyond the apex
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'If the file is within the canal and does not extend beyond the apex, it can be included in the obturation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the situation.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a ledge in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: A deviation of the canal created by incorrect instrumentation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A ledge is a deviation in the canal wall.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will avoid ledges.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to correct a ledge?' Mina answers:
options: With pre-curved files and a pre-flaring technique
By forcing with a straight file
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pre-curved files help find the original canal.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use pre-curved files.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a canal perforation?' Mina answers:
options: An artificial communication between the canal and periapical tissues
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A perforation is an accidental opening in the canal wall.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will be careful not to perforate.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to treat a canal perforation?' Mina answers:
options: Repair with MTA or bioceramic material
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bioceramic materials can repair perforations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in perforation repair.'

questions.question: Sami, after mastering root canal treatment with Mina, says: 'I'm ready to take on all challenges!' Mina concludes: 'Mastery of root canal treatment is...'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastery of root canal treatment is the foundation of endodontics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to improve.'
